title: Cloudflare Workers API – Delayed or Inconsistent Responses

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating an issue affecting the Workers API and Workers configuration in the Cloudflare dashboard. Customers may see out-of-date or inconsistent information when viewing or managing Workers. For example, recent deployments or configuration changes may not show up right away. Workers that are already running in production are not affected. We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: Multiple fixes are underway to address the underlying problem.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: Fixes have been deployed to production and inconsistent reads no longer appear to occurring. Continuing to monitor throughout the remainder of the day.
timeline.label: monitoring
